components.name: Poster Button
components.description: 3px ink border on paper; inverts to ink on hover. Primary is F1 red.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn">Race it against PIA</button> <button class="ds-btn ds-primary">Next lap</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--face, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 20px 12px; border: 3px solid #111; background: #f1f0ec; color: #111; font-weight: 850; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 118; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-size: 0.82rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #111; color: #f1f0ec; } .ds-primary { background: #e10600; border-color: #e10600; color: #fff; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #111; border-color: #111; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e10600; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Bordered strip with 3px dividers; the active option is an ink block.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 3px solid #111; background: #f1f0ec; } .ds-seg button { font-family: var(--face, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 8px 12px; font-weight: 750; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #3a3936; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 3px solid #111; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #111; color: #f1f0ec; }

components.name: Grid Row
components.description: Team chip, wide code, bar, tabular percentage. Yellow when picked; green ring for the truth.
components.css: .ds-row { font-family: var(--face, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6px 46px 1fr 40px; gap: 10px; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 6px; background: #f1f0ec; color: #111; } .ds-row i { height: 16px; } .ds-row b { font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 125; font-size: 0.86rem; } .ds-row span { height: 8px; background: #d9d6cf; } .ds-row em { display: block; height: 100%; background: #e10600; } .ds-row small { text-align: right; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.76rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row.pick { background: #f5c518; } .ds-row.pick em { background: #3a3936; }

components.css: .ds-who { font-family: var(--face, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); padding: 18px 28px 20px; background: var(--team); color: var(--on-team); } .ds-who h2 { margin: 12px 0 10px; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 125; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 0.9; font-size: 3rem; } .ds-who p { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 5px 9px 4px; background: #11803d; color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Telemetry Meter
components.description: 12px bar in a 2px ink border; ink for throttle, red for brake.
components.css: .ds-meter { display: block; width: 200px; height: 12px; margin: 6px 0; border: 2px solid #111; background: #f1f0ec; } .ds-meter em { display: block; height: 100%; background: #111; } .ds-meter.brk em { background: #e10600; }

components.name: Framed Stage
components.description: The 3D view as a framed picture with a paper caption tab.
components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; margin: 0; height: 180px; border: 3px solid #111; background: #e6e4de; } .ds-frame figcaption { font-family: var(--face, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 8px 12px; background: #f1f0ec; border-top: 3px solid #111; border-right: 3px solid #111; font-weight: 700; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 112; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; font-size: 0.72rem; }

narrative.overview: Blind Lap is a race poster you can play: light paper, heavy wide ink type, one F1-red brand block, team colours as flat fields owned by a named driver. The 3D circuit is a framed picture on the poster. Every page has a top bar and every lap a Menu exit; the home page is a hub of four ways to play. It replaced an all-black tyre-rubber world the owner found bland and confusing.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground, ink type, one red block; no shadows, gradients, glass or rounded corners.
3px ink rules between panels, 1px hairlines between rows.
Archivo variable: wdth 125 weight 900 for names and numbers, wdth 100 for sentences.
The 3D stage is framed and captioned, never full-bleed under floating UI.
Team colour fills the reveal block and chips, nothing else.

rules.name: The Owned Colour Rule
rules.body: Team colour appears only where a named driver owns it: the who-block field, the chip beside a code, the car after the reveal, duel swatches, DNA chips. Never on buttons, charts or text.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the brand and the primary action, and the strongest live signal (the model's leader, braking). Anything else that wants attention uses ink.

rules.name: The Width Is Rank Rule
rules.body: Names and numbers are wide and heavy; sentences are normal width and never in capitals.

rules.name: The Always An Exit Rule
rules.body: Every page shows the top bar; the lap hides it and shows a Menu button top-left instead. Escape also returns to the menu.

rules.name: The Framed Picture Rule
rules.body: The 3D scene sits in a 3px frame with a caption tab; UI never floats over it except the start lights and the pause banner.

dos: Frame the 3D stage and caption it with a paper tab.
Give every lap screen a Menu exit top-left.
Set names and numbers wide and heavy.
Use team colour as a whole field when a driver is named.
Use the one out-curve for movement and tabular numerals for changing numbers.
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients, glass, blur or rounded corners.
Don't float UI over a full-bleed scene.
Don't put team colour on buttons, charts or text.
Don't add a third signal colour; use ink and a mark.
Don't set sentences wide or in capitals.
